item.title: Police: Man arrested on sexual exploitation charges had 'previous interactions' with missing Colerain girl
item.description: The Colerain Township Police Department said the man, 43-year-old Kyle Lawrence, is believed to have had previous interactions with missing Colerain Township teenager Madison Fields.

item.title: Amid utility corruption trial, leaked GOP bill would allow for electric companies to own nuclear
item.description: Ohio is moving to allow electric utilities to own nuclear power, according to a leaked bill draft obtained by News 5 Cleveland.

item.title: No. 21 Miami (Ohio) rallies past Western Michigan 69-67 to remain the only unbeaten Division I team
item.description: Miami extended the best start in program history and added to its school record for wins in a season. Miami also boasts the best start and longest win streak in MAC annals.
